description:
Execute one live HTTP 402 capability via Stripe credit or Base USDC x402 v2, returning output, receipt, and Ed25519 attestation. Use this after verifying schemas and cost; do not use for free dry-runs (x402_preview_capability) or pricing (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: supply spend_key/header or payment_signature/PAYMENT-SIGNATURE; pass flat fields in arguments (or {order} on dynamic routes); max_spend_cents aborts pre-debit above ceiling.
Behavior: reusing idempotency_key replays the receipt (mutated args return HTTP 409). Upstream HTTP >= 400 auto-refunds 100%; returns HTTP 401/402/403/404 on auth, balance, policy, or route errors.

approval_id.description: Single-use human spend escalation approval ticket identifier returned by x402_request_approval (format: sba_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sba_aabbccddeeff0011).

arguments.description: JSON input arguments expected by the target capability (e.g. {"destination": "annapolis"} for reality_harbor_state or {"query": "city dock"} for kb_search).

builder_code.description: Optional ERC-8021 partner builder attribution code (2-64 chars, e.g. "glama" or "codex") for disclosed partner revenue share.

capability_id.description: Priced capability identifier or route from x402_list_capabilities to execute (e.g. "reality_harbor_state", "kb_search", or "POST /switchboard/chunk").

idempotency_key.description: Stripe-standard idempotency key (8-128 chars, e.g. "run-2026-11-22-harbor-01") ensuring retries reuse the exact original reservation without double-charging.

max_spend_cents.description: Hard client-side spend ceiling in USD cents (e.g. 50 = $0.50). If the live capability price exceeds this value, execution aborts with HTTP 403 before any debit occurs.

payment_signature.description: Optional Base USDC x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value for direct on-chain settlement when executing without a Stripe sbk_* spend key.

spend_key.description: Stripe-funded master or delegated subagent spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Optional when the caller supplies the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_execute_capability

execution_attestation.description: Detached Ed25519 JWS cryptographic attestation binding request, response, and settlement.

ok.description: True when the capability executed and settled cleanly.

result.description: Upstream JSON payload returned by the executed capability.

title: Execute Paid X402 Capability
